title: Logistic growth rate against population
caption: With r = 0.5 per hour and K = 10⁹, dN/dt = rN(1 − N/K) is a parabola in N. At N = 5 × 10⁸ the rate is 1.25 × 10⁸ cells per hour, its maximum, half-way to K.
alt: A downward parabola of growth rate against population, zero at N = 0 and N = 10 to the 9, with its peak 1.25 at N = 5 (in units of 10 to the 8).
description: Measure N in units of 10⁸ cells, so K = 10 and the rate is in units of 10⁸ cells per hour.
The rate 0.5N(1 − N/10) is zero at N = 0 and N = 10.
Its maximum is at N = 5, where the rate is 1.25 (× 10⁸ cells per hour).

checks.name: the maximum rate is at N = K/2
